The cottage

An 800-square-foot guest cottage tucked away on Spy Pond in Arlington — a peaceful waterfront retreat that is still close to everything. Harvard Square is about 10 minutes away, and Boston and Logan Airport are 20–25 minutes.

The open living and dining space is lined with windows over the water — made for morning coffee and a good book. The bedroom has a queen bed, a large closet, and a desk for remote work, with woven shades and blackout liners for sleep. The sunlit kitchen is fully new, and the bathroom pairs cottage charm with a modern walk-in shower. Outside, the shared waterfront yard is yours to relax in, and your hosts — two families — live right next door.

Bedroom
1 queen bed with hybrid mattress, desk, full-length mirror, walk-in closet.

House rules

Please read these before booking — they are the same rules as our Airbnb listing, and booking direct means agreeing to them.

  • Check-in: 4:00–10:00 PM, self check-in by keypad. Earlier check-in on request when we can.
  • Checkout: by 11:00 AM. Please message us when you have departed, and lock up.
  • Minimum stay: 2 nights.
  • Guests: up to 4 overnight guests. The rate covers 2 guests; each guest beyond 2 is $50/night. Only guests on the reservation may stay overnight.
  • Shoes off inside, please.
  • Quiet hours: 10 PM – 8 AM.
  • No pets. No smoking or vaping. No parties or events. No commercial photography or filming.
  • Parking & driveway: one dedicated space, sized for a small to midsize car/SUV. The driveway is narrow with tight turns — large vehicles will find it challenging. Drive slowly at all times; our homes are close together and young children play outdoors.
  • Waterfront yard: shared and unfenced at the water's edge, reached by paved steps down a steep incline, with some heights without rails — please keep an extra eye on children.
  • Basement: off-limits, except washer/dryer use on request.
  • Good to know: some spaces are shared with the neighboring homes, and there is potential for everyday neighborhood noise.
  • Cancellation: full refund if you cancel 30 or more days before check-in. Cancellations inside 30 days of check-in are not refundable.
